question: If (5)/(13) of a certain number is added to (7)/(39) of the same number, the result is 132. Find the number.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

LCM of denominators 13 and 39 is 39.

Convert fractions to common denominator: 5/13 = 15/39.

Total units = 15 units + 7 units = 22 units.

Given: 22 units = 132.

1 unit = 132 ÷ 22 = 6.

Original number = 39 units = 39 × 6 = 234.

**∴ The correct answer is 234.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given: 5/13 of a number + 7/39 of the same number = 132.
